request.description: Contractor selects project and sends work request to laborer. Calculates total days and total cost.
Laborer views received work requests in PENDING status.
Laborer accepts work request. Creates labor assignment, connects laborer to project, and sets availability status to WORKING.
Tests double assignment prevention. Requesting overlapping dates with an active assignment returns 400 Bad Request.
Laborer checks their ongoing project assignments.
Contractor views all labor assignments assigned to their project.
Marks assignment and request as COMPLETED, and restores laborer availability to AVAILABLE.
Laborer rejects incoming work request with reason.
Contractor cancels pending work request.
